_meta.note: Criterion names, levels, principles and guideline text are from W3C for all 87 criteria. Sufficient techniques and documented failures are populated for 0 of 87 entries. This usually means the source fetch used to generate this file did not include full technique data. Re-run this script on a machine with access to w3.org to enrich every entry in place: node scripts/build-remediation-library.js
